glossaryHelp.message: Write one “source,translation” pair per line. Choose a site to use the list only there.

highQualityOffer.message: You can try the higher-accuracy model (2B, about 1.81 GB). Speed depends on this device.

idleLabel.message: Release the model from memory after

licenseModelNote.message: The model weights are not bundled. They are downloaded from the official Hugging Face repository when they are not already stored on this device.

licensesBody.message: The full PLaMo Community License and this extension's MIT license are bundled with the extension.

localServerExperimental.message: Experimental: translation accuracy is not guaranteed. Output can differ from the built-in engine, including mistranslations.

localServerExperimentalConfirm.message: This engine is experimental. Accuracy is not guaranteed. Translations can differ from the built-in engine, including mistranslations. Use the local server anyway?

localServerFailed.message: The local server could not translate this. Open Settings. The original text was kept.

localServerHelp.message: Sends Sakutto's prompt to an OpenAI-compatible server on this computer, such as mlx_lm.server or LM Studio.

localServerLicenseNote.message: Other models you load on that server are yours to license. PLaMo weights stay under the PLaMo Community License.

localServerModelHelp.message: The model name loaded on that server.

localServerModelMissing.message: The server has no matching model. Load a model or pick one in Settings.

localServerNonLocalWarning.message: This address is not this computer. Page text will be sent there. I understand.

localServerParallelHelp.message: How many completions the server may run at once (1–16). Default is 8. The page keeps extra requests ready so a finished slot is not left idle.

localServerPermissionDenied.message: The browser did not grant access to this address.

localServerRemoteConfirmRequired.message: This address is not on this computer. Check the confirmation below before testing the connection.

localServerTestOkUnlisted.message: Connected. Completions work. The server listed no models — keep the model name you typed; it was not verified from /v1/models.

localServerTimeout.message: The local server timed out. The original text was kept.

localServerUnreachable.message: Could not reach the local server. Open Settings and check that it is running.

localServerUrlHelp.message: mlx_lm.server defaults to port 8080. LM Studio defaults to port 1234.

mailBannerAccessNeeded.message: Mail translation needs access to this site.

modelExportFailed.message: The model file could not be exported.

modelExportMissing.message: There is no model file to export yet.

modelFolderBenefitKeep.message: The file stays if you clear this browser's data. Pick the same folder again and you skip the download.

modelFolderBenefitShare.message: Other profiles and other Chromium browsers can use it right away, with no extra download.

modelFolderBenefitSpace.message: One copy on disk, so you save space ($SIZE$).

modelFolderHeading.message: Share the model folder across Chromium browsers

modelFolderHelp.message: The default is still storage inside this browser.

modelFolderIntegrityFailed.message: The file $FILE$ is not the official PLaMo model, so Sakutto will not use it.

modelFolderPermissionPresent.message: The model is already in the folder. Allow access to use it.

modelFolderPersistentHint.message: A folder chosen from the Settings tab can keep access after a restart. If the browser offers “Allow on every visit”, choosing it may help; the prompt may not appear (Japanese Chrome: 「サイトアクセス時は常に許可」, Japanese Edge: 「常に許可」). A one-click re-grant may still be needed.

modelFolderPickFailed.message: The folder could not be selected.

modelImportDone.message: The model file was imported and verified.

modelImportFailed.message: The model file could not be imported.

modelImportWrongFile.message: That file is not the official PLaMo model ($FILE$). Choose the matching official .gguf file.

modelSelectionFallback.message: The selected model is not on this device, so Sakutto switched to an installed one.

modelSelectionMissing.message: No translation model is installed. Download one to translate.

onboardingAgeNotice.message: If you are under 18 or otherwise not old enough to enter a contract on your own, a parent or guardian's consent is required.

onboardingBridgeNote.message: The page keeps its original text until the model is ready, then PLaMo translates it. Google documents Chrome's translation as on-device.

onboardingBridgeNoteFirefox.message: The page keeps its original text until the model is ready, then PLaMo translates it.

onboardingCommercialBody.message: This includes using it for work inside a company. Both of the following are required.

onboardingCommercialRevenue.message: Income or sales for you or your affiliates in the most recent fiscal year of 1 billion yen or less

onboardingCommercialUnmetBody.message: Commercial use then needs a separate license from PFN.

onboardingCommercialUnmetHeading.message: When the conditions are not met

onboardingConsentSentence.message: Pressing "Agree to the license and start" means you agree to the PLaMo Community License.

onboardingHttpError.message: The model download failed (HTTP $STATUS$). Please try again.

onboardingLead.message: Page translation runs on this device by default. The PLaMo 3 model is downloaded only when it is not already stored here.

onboardingLocalServerNote.message: Settings can turn on an experimental local server. Page text then goes only to the address you set, and accuracy is not guaranteed.

onboardingModelNote.message: The default model (573 MB) downloads to this device. A sustained 100 Mbps transfer of that size is about 46 seconds before overhead; real time varies. An interrupted download resumes.

onboardingPrivacyNote.message: The built-in engine does not send page text to a server.

onboardingReadyCompose.message: Press $KEY$ while typing in a message box to preview a translation you can apply.

onboardingReadyContext.message: Right-click the page and choose "Translate this page". For selected text, choose "Translate the selected text".

onboardingReadyLead.message: You can translate pages on this device.

onboardingReadyPage.message: Press $KEY$ to translate the whole page. Press it again to restore the original.

onboardingReadyToolbar.message: Click the toolbar icon to translate the open page.

onboardingReconsentBody.message: You agreed to the PLaMo Community License earlier. Here is the clearer summary of the terms, so you can agree once more. Your downloaded model stays on this device.

onboardingReconsentHeading.message: The PLaMo terms are now easier to read

onboardingStart.message: Agree to the license and start

onboardingStartFailed.message: Setup could not start. Please try again.

onboardingStartNotice.message: Pressing "Agree to the license and start" means you agree to the whole PLaMo Community License.

onboardingStoreFolder.message: Use a shared model folder (Chromium browsers)

onboardingStoreFolderHelp.message: For people who use Chrome, Edge, or another Chromium browser: one model copy is shared between them.

onboardingUseNow.message: Chrome's built-in translator is used only for the language pairs PLaMo does not support.

onboardingWhileDownloading.message: While the model downloads, pages keep their original text; nothing is translated until PLaMo is ready.

openPdf.description: Button that opens the PDF the current tab shows in the extension's reader.

openPdfHint.message: Opens the PDF in Sakutto and translates it in place, keeping the page layout.

optionsDefaultHint.message: These are the defaults. A site you translate can keep its own language and reading style.

optionsLead.message: Choose how translation works, manage the model, and set per-site behavior. Changes save automatically.

optionsSiteLive.message: Language and reading style here follow the site. The settings above are used when a site has no choice of its own.

paceHelp.message: Translates paragraphs just before they scroll into view. "Look ahead further" prefetches more below the fold, so the text is ready when you scroll. For the languages PLaMo supports, every line comes from PLaMo; Chrome's draft is never used.

paceHelpFirefox.message: Translates paragraphs just before they scroll into view. "Look ahead further" prefetches more below the fold, so the text is ready when you scroll. Every line comes from PLaMo.

pagePartial.message: $BLOCKS$ parts of this page could not be translated.

pageStartBlocked.message: Page translation waits until the PLaMo model finishes downloading and loads. Open onboarding to see the progress.

pdfBroken.message: The document could not be opened. It may be damaged, or protected by a password.

pdfFailedCount.description: Toolbar note when some blocks could not be translated.

pdfFileAccessDenied.message: This PDF is a file on this computer. Allow this extension to access file URLs in the browser's extension settings, or choose the file in the reader.

pdfKeptAsIs.message: $COUNT$ parts were left as the page set them: equations, axis ticks, and code keep their original typesetting.

pdfMissing.message: The document is no longer available. Open the PDF again from its tab.

pdfModelMissing.message: The pages are shown, but translating them needs the PLaMo model. Download it to translate this document.

pdfNoText.message: This document is a scan or a set of pictures, with no text layer to translate. Open a PDF that contains real text, or run optical character recognition first.

pdfOverflow.message: $COUNT$ parts did not fit on the page. Open the marker to read the translation.

pdfPageNoText.message: This page is a scan or a picture — it has no selectable text, so nothing here can be translated.

pdfRenderFailed.message: This page could not be drawn.

pdfSelectFailed.message: This selection could not be translated.

pdfSelectHint.message: Select text on a page to translate just that part.

pdfTooLarge.message: This file is larger than 200 MB, which is the largest document the reader can open.

pdfTranslateFailed.message: This part could not be translated.

plainTextLineBreaksHelp.message: Pasted documents, OCR text, and book excerpts often break mid-sentence. Those breaks are joined for translation; only sentence ends, headings, and blank lines appear as breaks in the translation. Page translation is unchanged.

privacyBody.message: By default this extension does not send page text to a translation server. There is no telemetry.

privacyBodyLocalServer.message: Experimental. If you choose a local server, text is sent only to the address you set (by default this computer). Accuracy is not guaranteed, and translations can differ from the built-in engine, including mistranslations. The developer does not receive the text.

privacyDestinations.message: The extension's own request is the model download. It starts at huggingface.co and follows Hugging Face's redirect to its CDN. Page text is not included. Chrome downloads its language packs itself. A local server you enable is a separate, optional path to the address you set.

privacyDestinationsFirefox.message: The extension's own request is the model download. It starts at huggingface.co and follows Hugging Face's redirect to its CDN. Page text is not included. A local server you enable is a separate, optional path to the address you set.

settingsGmailBanner.message: Offer to translate Gmail and Outlook messages

settingsGmailBannerHelp.message: When this is on, an opened Gmail or Outlook message written in another language shows a small banner above its body. The message is translated only after you click. Sakutto needs access to the mail site; grant it from the popup or the site list.

settingsGmailNoAutoLangs.message: No languages set to always translate.

settingsGmailNoNeverLangs.message: No languages set to never translate.

shortcutBilingual.message: $KEY$ switches between replacement and bilingual view, and remembers the choice for this site.

shortcutCompose.message: $KEY$ translates the text in the field you are typing in.

shortcutFallbackNote.message: Chrome never assigned a key to this command, so the default is handled on web pages. It does not work on chrome:// pages or other pages Sakutto cannot enter. In a text field the keydown is left unprevented.

shortcutFallbackNoteFirefox.message: Firefox never assigned a key to this command, so the default is handled on pages. In a text field the keydown is left unprevented.

shortcutHelp.message: Uncheck a command to turn it off in Sakutto. Change shortcuts opens Chrome’s own editor. A key Chrome assigned is used as-is, including while a text field is focused (the page still translates). If Chrome never assigned a command, the default still works on web pages — not on chrome:// pages or other pages Sakutto cannot enter. In a text field that unassigned keydown is delivered and left unprevented, so Option+letter can type a character.

shortcutHelpFirefox.message: Uncheck a command to turn it off in Sakutto. Change shortcuts opens Firefox’s own editor. A key you set there is used as-is, including while a text field is focused. An update restores a command that was never assigned, when Firefox allows it; a key you cleared stays cleared. Never-assigned commands still work on pages until then. In a text field that unassigned keydown is left unprevented so it can type.

shortcutTranslate.message: $KEY$ translates the page or restores the original.

siteGrantBody.message: Pages on $HOST$ will be translated on this device.

siteGrantDenied.message: Permission was not granted. Try again.

siteGrantInvalid.message: This page does not name a site.

slowDeviceHint.message: PLaMo is slow on this PC. Each paragraph appears as the model finishes it.

tagline.message: Page translation that runs on your device

targetAdjustedNote.message: The page is already in the saved target language, so the target was switched.

tierHelp.message: Automatic picks the mode that fits this PC.

translationPopupSizeHelp.message: Changes the text size in hover, selection, and compose translation popups. Video captions use their own size setting.

typedChromeOnlyNote.message: Chrome's built-in translator covers $LANGUAGES$ on pages only; typed text is never sent to it.

typedChromeOnlyTarget.message: Typed translation uses PLaMo only, and PLaMo does not translate into $LANGUAGE$. Pick another language here, or translate a page for the built-in translator.

typedCopyFailed.message: Could not copy the translation. Select it and copy it yourself.

typedDirectionHint.message: Translates into $LANGUAGE$. Other languages are detected automatically.

typedFailed.message: The text could not be translated. Your text is unchanged; try again.

typedLead.message: Type or paste text and translate it with the same PLaMo model the page translation uses. Nothing leaves this device.

typedModelBusy.message: The PLaMo model is downloading. Translation starts once it is ready.

typedModelError.message: The PLaMo model could not load. Open the options page to check it.

typedModelMissing.message: The PLaMo model is not on this device yet.

typedModelPartial.message: The PLaMo model download was interrupted.

typedNeedsConsent.message: PLaMo needs a one-time licence agreement before it can run. Your text is not translated until then.

typedPlaceholder.message: Type or paste the text here.

typedResultEmpty.message: The PLaMo translation appears here, beside the text you pasted.

typedRunHint.message: Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter on a Mac) translates too.

typedTooLong.message: This text is too long for one request. Shorten it to $LIMIT$ characters or fewer.

unofficialNotice.message: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Preferred Networks. Built with PLaMo.

videoCaptionsCustomHostDenied.message: Access to that site was not granted.

videoCaptionsCustomHostInvalid.message: Enter a domain such as example.com. The only wildcard allowed is a leading *.

videoCaptionsCustomSitesHelp.message: Add a domain that is not YouTube or X. Translation works only when the site exposes captions as HTML5 video tracks, WebVTT, or a visible caption element. Sites that draw captions only as custom graphics are not supported. Access is requested for that domain when you add it.

videoCaptionsDisplayHelp.message: Keeping the original line makes it easier to study and to catch a bad translation.

videoCaptionsOriginalToggleHelp.message: When this is off, the button stays off the video. You can still switch original and translation from this page.

videoCaptionsOriginalToggleSetting.message: Show the hide-original button on the player

videoCaptionsPermissionDenied.message: Access to YouTube and X was not granted.

videoCaptionsPositionHelp.message: Press and hold a translated caption to move it. YouTube and X remember their own spots, including fullscreen and theater. This puts the caption back at the bottom of the player.

videoCaptionsSettingHelp.message: When this is on, YouTube (including live) and X videos that already have captions are translated on your device as they play. Chrome asks for access to those sites when you turn the setting on. You can add other sites below if they expose captions in a standard way. Videos with no captions stay silent. If a line cannot be translated reliably, the original stays.

videoCaptionsSizeHelp.message: The size follows the player, including fullscreen and theater. Drag the slider to preview.
